title: Blocked Transpose
prompt: ISO C. Implement `void transpose_blocked(int *dst, const int *src, size_t n, size_t block)` — standard n-by-n transpose, walking the matrix in block-by-block tiles (the cache-friendly order). For every i,j: dst[j*n+i] = src[i*n+j]. block 0 must be treated as 1. Correctness is what is tested; the tiling is the lesson.

tests.name: 3x3 identity check
tests.hint: Transposition is dst[j*n+i] = src[i*n+j]; tiling must not change the math.

tests.name: block smaller than 1 clamps
tests.hint: block 0 is nonsense; clamping to 1 keeps the code total.

tests.name: block larger than n
tests.hint: A block bigger than the matrix degenerates to a plain transpose — and stays correct.
